# Shared Test Execution

Agents can select quick direct proof or run long test batches through the existing harness without
model polling inside the runner. The new Test Execution skill is routed from managed repository
instructions and Plan, Work and Review guidance.

- Deterministic batches share durable jobs, workspace/output claims, deadlines, process cleanup and
  compact result inspection with existing provider work. Projects retain their tests, assertions,
  input completeness and device-lock/cleanup authority.
- An externally launched managed cycle supports Codex and Claude: preparation exits, tests run,
  then one exact-session follow-up assesses the result. Existing native adapters require full-access
  authority. Arbitrary desktop/IDE automatic return is not claimed.
- Light local telemetry records reported use, execution choices, outcomes, duration and available
  token totals in the existing bounded file. It collects no prompts, commands or test output and
  does not infer savings from usage counts.

Adopt this release deliberately. It refreshes managed host instructions and disables automatic
startup adoption for this release. Start a fresh host session after setup. Deterministic batch
records use protocol 2; older harness executables sharing that job store refuse unfamiliar records.
Use the matching current helper for the store. Ordinary governance checks remain available.
